{"consolidated_memory":"billing/invoice_totals.py: Two instances of off-by-one cent error in totals calculator (Python stack, covered by tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py)

**Incident 1 [2026-03-21]**
- Problem: off-by-one cent in totals calculator
- Reproduction: total an invoice with three prorated lines
- Signal: one cent gap in reconciliation report
- Trigger: only affected jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: an error swallowed by a bare except handler
- Fix: narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #1257 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1
- Outcome: alert stayed quiet for 62 consecutive days after fix

**Incident 2 [2026-07-17]**
- Problem: off-by-one cent in totals calculator
- Reproduction: total an invoice with three prorated lines
- Signal: one cent gap in reconciliation report
- Trigger: only affected staging read replica
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #2332 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-2
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 1.4 percent to under 6 per 10,000 (0.06%)"}
